rationale: The agent correctly bumped the sqlglot version constraint in setup.py and installed sqlglot 27.7.0, but it did not update the source code to handle the breaking change where sqlglot 27.7 promoted several functions (date_from_unix_date, reverse, unix_micros, unix_millis) from exp.Anonymous to dedicated expression classes. The verifier test explicitly checks that these functions pass, and the agent's final test run still shows failures for test_invoke_anonymous on those four functions. The reference patch shows the required source changes in sqlframe/base/functions.py to use invoke_expression_over_column with the new expression classes instead of invoke_anonymous_function.
